section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1978
title: 24 ## Causes of Suicides : The total number of suicide cases reported during 1978 has been classified under different heads and the last category 'Other Causes' cover the unspecified causes of suicides. The major cause of suicides during 1978 was 'Dreadful Diseases' which accounted for 16·6 percent of total suicidal deaths. The second important cause was 'Quarrel with Parents-in-Law' (9·3%) followed by 'Love Affairs' (5·8%), 'Quarrel with Spouse' (5·7%), 'Poverty' (2·8%), 'Insanity' (2·8%), 'Dispute over property' (2·1%), 'Failure in Examination' (1·5%), 'Fall in Social Reputation' (1·2%), 'Unemployment' (1·1%), 'Bankruptcy or Sudden Change in Economic Position' (0·9%), and 'Deaths of Dear Presons' (0·5%). The category 'Other Causes' accounted for 49·7 percent of the total suicides registered during 1978. The detailed statistics are presented in Table-III.
